_readme: Combat's numbers, read when the demo starts (combat/CombatTuning.java). Change any value and restart; one left out keeps its default. dice.wandHeavy: the dice a wand's heavy attack rolls (no spell in it); cooldowns.heavySeconds: the least time between two heavy attacks; cooldowns.dodgeSeconds: the least time from the end of one dodge (the dash, the roll) to the start of the next. armour (world/Armour.java): a blow lands on the head, torso, arms, legs or feet, as often as armour.locations weights them; every piece worn there rolls armour.perRarity dice of its rarity (its sides are the piece's: leather d4, mail d6, iron d8, steel d10) and their total is taken off the blow, down to armour.minDamage; armour.everyPieceRolls true makes every piece worn roll at every blow, wherever it lands. stamina: what each blow costs (swing, heavy, spin, jumpAttack, shot, spell); without the stamina for it a blow does stamina.tiredDamage of its damage (0.7: 70%). Running and sprinting cost stamina too (world/Player.java RUN_COST, SPRINT_COST). The borders' own numbers (Venom +50% over 10 s, Mystic x2.5 damage and 2x mana, Bonded +10% a living target hit in 5 minutes) are in world/Border.java.
